ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a circumscribed quadrilateral of circle $\odot O$, and $AB=10$, $CD=15$. What is the perimeter of quadrilateral $ABCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
$\because$ Quadrilateral ABCD is a circumscribed quadrilateral of $\odot$O,\\
$\therefore$AE = AH, BE = BF, CF = CG, DH = DG,\\
$\therefore$AD + BC = AB + CD = 25,\\
$\therefore$The perimeter of quadrilateral ABCD = AD + BC + AB + CD = 25 + 25 = \boxed{50}
